narrative.overview: A record to check, not a show to watch. Every mark traces to a definition. Neutral warm-gray chrome; photos and party colors are the only strong color. Flat, with hairlines separating. No site voice or generated copy.
keyCharacteristics: Three columns on desktop: controls, graph, detail.
Dense data stays readable by being quiet.

rules.name: The Data-Only Color Rule
rules.body: Red and blue appear only where they encode party: nodes, edges, bars, the party dot. Never in buttons, banners, headings, or backgrounds.

rules.name: The Quiet Chrome Rule
rules.body: The interface around the graph stays neutral so the graph is the loudest thing on screen.

rules.name: The Label-Only Caps Rule
rules.body: Uppercase only for labels and section headings, never for sentences.

rules.name: The Hairline Rule
rules.body: Separate with a 1px Hairline Stone border. No drop shadows, no glows.

dos: **Do** keep chrome neutral and let the graph carry the color.
**Do** keep definitions one click away from every number.
**Do** show members with no links as unlinked nodes.
donts: **Don't** give it "shiny dash" vibes: no gradient cards, big KPI tiles, glossy panels, or default Shiny/dashboard styling.
**Don't** use anything polarizing: no loud partisan red/blue in the interface, no campaign or attack-ad styling, no rankings or labels that read as accusation.
**Don't** add shadows, glows, or decorative motion.
**Don't** write or generate site copy or a "voice"; copy is the author's.
